sloka: पित्रा दशरथेन त्वम् श्वशुरेण मम अनघ ।पूर्वैसः च पितृभिः सार्धम् नूनम् स्वर्गे समागतः ।। ६-३२-१८।।
transliteration: pitrā daśarathena tvam śvaśureṇa mama anagha ।pūrvaisaḥ ca pitṛbhiḥ sārdham nūnam svarge samāgataḥ ।। 6-32-18।।

translations.english: "O Sinless one! Surely you have reached heaven where your father, my fatherinlaw Dasaratha and your grandfathers have reached."
